name: Microsoft Teams
hint: An app registration in Microsoft Entra with these application permissions, admin-consented: Team.ReadBasic.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All, TeamMember.Read.All, ChannelMember.Read.All, ChannelMessage.Read.All, Chat.Read.All, and Channel.Create, TeamMember.ReadWriteNonOwnerRole.All for the writes; the token address holds your directory ID.

pick.name: list_teams
pick.says: Lists the teams in the organization with only id, displayName, description and visibility filled; get_team returns the rest.

pick.name: get_team
pick.says: Returns one team’s properties, by its ID.

pick.name: list_channels
pick.says: Lists a team’s channels. A select without email makes it faster, e.g. id,displayName,description,membershipType.

pick.name: get_channel
pick.says: Returns one channel. Its summary comes back only when select names it, and leaving email out of select makes it faster.

pick.name: list_channel_messages
pick.says: Lists a channel’s messages without their replies, 20 to a page or up to 50 by top; expand=replies brings the replies along.

pick.name: list_message_replies
pick.says: Lists the replies to one channel message, up to 50 by top.

pick.name: get_channel_message
pick.says: Returns one message in a channel.

pick.name: list_team_members
pick.says: Lists a team’s members, 100 to a page or up to 999 by top; roles holds owner or guest where a member is one.

pick.name: list_channel_members
pick.says: Lists a channel’s direct members, 100 to a page or up to 999 by top.

pick.name: list_joined_teams
pick.says: Lists the teams a user is a direct member of, by user ID or sign-in name (ada@school.edu), with only id, displayName, description, isArchived and the directory ID filled; get_team returns the rest.

pick.name: list_user_chats
pick.says: Lists the chats a user is part of, by user ID or sign-in name. top is at most 50, expand takes members (25 at most) or lastMessagePreview, and orderby only lastMessagePreview/createdDateTime desc.

pick.name: list_chat_messages
pick.says: Lists a chat’s messages, last changed first, up to 50 by top. filter works only beside an orderby on the same field: createdDateTime desc with lt, or lastModifiedDateTime desc with gt and lt.

pick.name: create_channel
pick.says: Creates a channel in a team; displayName is at most 50 characters. Body: {"displayName", "description", "membershipType": "standard"}.

pick.name: add_team_member
pick.says: Adds a user to a team as a member; guests cannot be added this way, and the member list can take a while to show it. Body: {"@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember", "roles": [], "user@odata.bind": "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('<user ID>')"}.
